inputReports.scope: Actual public new-game/dialogue/settings/export/movement and one first-Eden combat order through real Tab navigation and a declared mock standard Gamepad API. No private campaign input or application handler is injected.

Public mission gates, naturally timed six-second disarming, pause, four charges, three MIRA stations, Vigil window, actual timeout/retry, chapter transition and save/reload. Earlier chapter progress and position-only transfers are declared fixtures.

Real public Wait-mode gauge reservation, pure draft/cancellation, two coordinated native shots, real tactical movement/range feedback, victory claim and actual save/reload. Desktop/mobile UI. No private state, ATB/HP/clock mutation, CSS injection or QA query.

Public talent purchases, armour shared budget, class prerequisite, actual exports, manual save/load, automatic reload and rejection of a malformed talent import; desktop and mobile. No campaign victory or talent combat action is claimed played by this collector.

Development-only detached native WorldView plus the real tactical toolbar component. Benezia and Thorian transitions use the actual native engine with tactical:true/bossPhases:true. Current source files and unchanged local atlas bytes are identified. No app campaign is begun or public victory claimed.

Native trusted blur/focus suspension during real tab changes while walking and during an active ATB battle; native save downloads verify unchanged position/resources. No forced frame rate or physical hardware performance claim.

scope: Six current development family executions and their actually opened SHA-bound reviews; native results remain separately attributed. No original-game likeness, full campaign traversal or physical-input certification is inferred.
limitations: Image opening belongs to the cited reviewers; this composer performs hash checks and aggregation only.
Historical reports and superseded UI attempts remain outside the current gate. Every accepted source hash is current.
Final production must be tested after catalogue synchronization and compilation.

images.label: eden-gate
images.source: Actual public viewport; no DOM, pose, CSS or private-state injection.
observations: Les règles des quatre charges, du délai, des six secondes immobiles et de la pause sont lisibles. Les deux choix restent entièrement dans le dialogue ; le commando reste visible au-dessus.

images.label: eden-charge-dialogue
images.source: Actual public viewport; no DOM, pose, CSS or private-state injection.
observations: Le choix Désamorcer la charge indique six secondes immobile ; la sortie reste accessible et le HUD affiche 0/4 avec cinq minutes.

images.label: eden-save-pauses-channel
images.source: Actual public viewport; no DOM, pose, CSS or private-state injection.
observations: Le menu de pause et les commandes de sauvegarde/export sont lisibles. La sortie continue plus bas dans le défilement. La preuve du gel du canal provient des deux exports identiques, pas de cette seule image.

images.label: eden-four-charges-complete
images.source: Actual public viewport; no DOM, pose, CSS or private-state injection.
observations: Le journal affiche quatre charges cochées et le temps restant. Le résumé distingue les charges neutralisées de la dernière défense et de la balise encore à rejoindre.

images.label: eden-timeout
images.source: Actual public viewport; no DOM, pose, CSS or private-state injection.
observations: L’échec est visible dans le HUD et dans le dialogue. Le bouton de reprise et ses effets sur les charges, le délai et les ressources sont lisibles.

images.label: mira-gate
images.source: Actual public viewport; no DOM, pose, CSS or private-state injection.
observations: Le dialogue MIRA décrit les trois stations sans coût ajouté. Les deux choix sont visibles et le commando reste dégagé devant les laboratoires.

images.label: mira-repair-dialogue
images.source: Actual public viewport; no DOM, pose, CSS or private-state injection.
observations: Le relais de communication possède sa ligne et son choix de remise en service. Le HUD indique 0/3 ; aucun texte de dialogue n’est coupé.

images.label: mira-three-stations
images.source: Actual public viewport; no DOM, pose, CSS or private-state injection.
observations: Le journal défilé montre les trois stations cochées, leur résumé et les règles de persistance. Le haut du journal se trouve volontairement au-dessus du viewport.

images.label: ilos-objective
images.source: Actual public viewport; no DOM, pose, CSS or private-state injection.

images.label: vigil-window-dialogue
images.source: Actual public viewport; no DOM, pose, CSS or private-state injection.
observations: Le bouton d’activation de la fenêtre est lisible. Au point préparé sur le marqueur, la projection filaire de Vigil recouvre partiellement les trois corps, qui restent identifiables ; mise en scène Prototype à affiner.

images.label: conduit-arrival
images.source: Actual public viewport; no DOM, pose, CSS or private-state injection.

images.label: ilos-passage-reached
images.source: Actual public viewport; no DOM, pose, CSS or private-state injection.
